comparison.objective: Extract and replace an instrument through a loose-walled port without moving the port; candidate removes four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained axial extraction/insertion with port stabilization versus constrained mandrel alignment plus bimanual impact, fracture, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Instrument exchanged while port displacement stays safe versus four valid fractures, all fragments contained, and inserts/shell undamaged. Numeric port tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared axial alignment and hazard avoidance do not erase the different tested ability: exchange through a port versus contact-driven break-off and recovery.
